about.heading: About Us
about.intro: Our journey began as passionate marble traders, meticulously sourcing exquisite stones from the heart of Italy. We connected with customers across Dubai, India, and Germany, inspired by a deep love for the timeless beauty of natural stone.
about.founded: In 2022, we founded MindMines with a clear mission: share fine materials and craftsmanship with a global audience. We believe each stone has a unique character—and we celebrate that individuality in every piece.
about.today: Today, fueled by our customers’ inspiration, we collaborate with skilled artisans to craft sculptures and decor from marble, granite, and even pebbles—each designed to resonate with beauty and sophistication.
about.vision: Our vision: bring warmth, elegance, and a touch of nature into homes and businesses through ethical sourcing and sustainable craftsmanship.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions (AGB)
terms.scopeText: These terms govern all B2C purchases via mindmines.eu. Contracting party: MindMines GbR, Feldstraße 11, 21640 Horneburg, Germany.
terms.definitionsText: “Customer” means a consumer within §13 BGB. “Products” are physical marble/stone items.
terms.orderingText: Items in the shop are non-binding. By placing an order you submit a binding offer. We accept by email confirmation or by dispatch of goods.
terms.pricingText: All prices include statutory VAT where applicable. Shipping costs are shown at checkout. You will receive a VAT invoice by email.
terms.paymentText: We accept PayPal, credit/debit cards (via Stripe), SEPA bank transfer, and Klarna (where available).
terms.shippingText: We ship to Germany and EU via DHL/partners. Delivery times are shown at checkout. For consumer sales, risk transfers upon delivery to you.
terms.withdrawalText: Consumers have 14 days to withdraw without giving reasons. Custom-made items are excluded. Details in the Return & Refund Policy.
terms.warrantyText: Statutory consumer rights under German law apply. Natural stone variations (color/veining) are not defects.
terms.titleRetentionText: Goods remain our property until paid in full (Eigentumsvorbehalt).
terms.liabilityText: We are liable for intent and gross negligence; for slight negligence only for breach of essential duties, capped to foreseeable damages.
terms.dataText: See our Privacy Policy for details on processing and cookies.
terms.jurisdictionText: German law applies; mandatory consumer protections of your residence remain. Place of jurisdiction: Amtsgericht Stade, Germany.
terms.finalText: If a clause is invalid, the remainder stays effective.

returns.title: Return & Refund Policy
returns.intro: You have 14 days to return most items. Custom-made products are non-refundable.
howItems: Email service@mindmines.eu with your order number within 14 days of delivery.
Use the original packaging when possible; protect heavy stone items carefully.
Ship to the return address below. You are responsible for return shipping unless the item is defective or we made a mistake.
returns.conditionText: Items must be unused and in resellable condition. Natural stone variations are normal and not defects.
returns.refundsText: Upon inspection, we refund to your original payment method within 14 days. Shipping fees are non-refundable unless due to our error.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.carriersText: DHL/partners handle delivery. Processing typically 1–2 business days.
shipping.costsText: Shown at checkout based on weight/size and destination. Heavy stone items may incur surcharges.
shipping.riskText: Risk transfers to you on delivery. If damaged, document with photos and contact support within 48 hours.
shipping.undeliverableText: If parcels return due to incorrect address/refusal, we can reship at cost or refund minus shipping.
